about: Typed voice rounds (Javanese/Indonesian) with the values the farmer said. Source: docs/evaluation.md, 'Voice logs', live check of 29-30 Oct 2026. Typed text, no audio: this scores the extraction step only (no ASR). Pond list as in the offline fixture of scripts/eval.ts.

items.transcript: Kolam A suhune selawe koma wolu, pH pitu koma papat. Kolam be suhune wolulikur, ana sing mati loro.
Kolam ce siji suhune selikur sanga koma lima, tds satus sewidak. Kolam pojok banyune rada ijo, pakane isih akeh.
Kolam B suhu dua puluh tujuh koma tiga, pH tujuh koma satu. Kolam A pH pitu papat, suhune nemlikur.
